address: 51 Old Airport Road Food Centre, #01-120, 51 Old Airport Road, 390051, Singapore
bio: Come here for flavourful made-to-order grouper broth with milk added for extra creaminess. Try the soup on its own or with bee hoon, sliced fish, fried fish meat and fried fish head. The spicy bean sauce and deep-fried shallot work magic with the broth....
